subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should the Tailscale/raw-100.x onboarding path from this PR be adopted into the current refreshed iOS onboarding flow, or should the branch be replaced by a narrower follow-up?
rationale: The branch is protected by the maintainer label and overlaps a merged onboarding refresh, so the remaining question is the desired product/UX integration shape rather than a deterministic cleanup close.

options.title: Rebase into current onboarding
options.body: Adopt the useful Tailscale and raw-IP blocking behavior on top of the current branded onboarding flow, then rerun focused iOS proof.

options.title: Replace with narrow follow-up
options.body: Close or pause this branch only after opening a smaller PR that ports the secure Tailscale behavior without the stale UI surface.

options.title: Fold into setup-code work
options.body: Coordinate this behavior with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98265 if maintainers want one combined gateway setup direction.

recommendation.title: Rebase into current onboarding
recommendation.body: Adopt the useful Tailscale and raw-IP blocking behavior on top of the current branded onboarding flow, then rerun focused iOS proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the overlapping onboarding refresh and authored this PR's Tailscale behavior, making them the clearest owner for the integration choice.
